WITH mid_june_week AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        calendar_year,
        week_number AS mid_week
    FROM cleaned_weekly_sales
    WHERE (calendar_year = 2018 AND week_number = 24)
       OR (calendar_year = 2019 AND week_number = 24)
       OR (calendar_year = 2020 AND week_number = 25)
),
before_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        mj.calendar_year,
        SUM(cs.sales) AS before_sum
    FROM mid_june_week mj
    JOIN cleaned_weekly_sales cs ON mj.calendar_year = cs.calendar_year AND cs.week_number BETWEEN mj.mid_week - 4 AND mj.mid_week - 1
    GROUP BY mj.calendar_year
),
after_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        mj.calendar_year,
        SUM(cs.sales) AS after_sum
    FROM mid_june_week mj
    JOIN cleaned_weekly_sales cs ON mj.calendar_year = cs.calendar_year AND cs.week_number BETWEEN mj.mid_week + 1 AND mj.mid_week + 4
    GROUP BY mj.calendar_year
)
SELECT 
    bs.calendar_year,
    bs.before_sum,
    asum.after_sum,
    (1.0 * (asum.after_sum - bs.before_sum) / bs.before_sum) * 100 AS pct_change
FROM before_sales bs
JOIN after_sales asum ON bs.calendar_year = asum.calendar_year
